description:
Record that a control was performed, with the fingerprint of the evidence (screenshot, export,
report). Hash-chained, so evidence cannot be back-dated after the fact without it showing. Requires the
organization API key.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the document (64 hex characters); the file stays with you
document_sha256.title: Document Sha256

performed_at.description: When it was done (ISO 8601). Default: now
performed_at.title: Performed At
